resolution: Cut the per-edit O(world) work in the hmsc-int editor so a place on a full map approaches the blank-map baseline. Three cuts, all cart/runtime TSX (hot-reloadable, no Zig rebuild): (1) 3022d8bb5 — the per-place snap raycast (raycastPieces) and the anchor scans (nearestPlateLatticeAnchor/nearestWallLineAnchor/topAnchorYAtEdge) were O(world) per click; they now query the cached PLACEPERF-0610 piece grid for grid-local candidates only. This also fixes the dominant appTick cost: the per-frame hover-snap inside the setTimeout __jsTick ran the SAME raycast. (2) 7e0a9027f — EditorLayout keeps both maps mounted; the 2D PaintCanvas re-rendered its O(world) markers on every 3D place (place memo dep buildFootprints) inside the loaderPane window; its place prop is now frozen while it is the unfocused PiP. (3) 9f786671d — the footprint census (mapBuildFootprints, ~30ms/place) is gated to the routes that show it (dashboard or 2D-focused), computed once on mount otherwise; also fixed a latent missing useRef import in useBuildUndo.ts from a prior uncommitted edit. snap.test 35/35, no regressions (2 placed failures pre-exist on HEAD from the parallel buildings work). TEMP probes left in place for the user's live A/B; cleanup commit follows verification.
